The plate is square, about 26 cm across (roughly 345 px in the image), so 1 px is about 0.075 cm. Each of the 5 small round patties is about 55 px wide, which is about 4 cm, and about 1.5 cm thick.

Volume of one patty: π × 2² × 1.5 ≈ 19 cm³. At a density of about 0.8 g/cm³ that comes to roughly 15 g. Five patties weigh about 75 g.

They look like baked vegetable or cheese bites, or small fritters, so I estimate about 230 kcal per 100 g.
